comment: Reviewed library cell for OpenTitan top_earlgrey at 92f3d03b0dcf6d5c1933a65d1497747f67d19f4c. The generic prim_clock_gating (hw/ip/prim_generic/rtl/prim_clock_gating.sv) captures en_i | test_en_i in a latch open while clk_i is low and drives clk_o = en_latch & clk_i: a latched clock gate of clk_i. test_en_i is the scan enable, which this top ties to the constant scan-mode-off value.
